finalists.label: Calcific Tendinitis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of soft-tissue calcification anterior to the C1 arch and extending from the longus colli muscle to the atlanto-odontoid joint.

finalists.label: Retropharyngeal calcific tendinitis
finalists.why: It has specific evidence of soft-tissue calcification anterior to the C1 arch and no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: Retropharyngeal calcific tendinitis is a subtype that accounts for the specific finding of soft-tissue calcification anterior to the C1 arch and has no evidence against it.
